content: FEEL operator precedence (lowest to highest): boxed expr < for/if/quantified < or < and < comparison(=,!=,<,<=,>,>=,between,in) < arithmetic(add/sub equal, mult/div equal higher, ** higher, unary - highest) < instance of < path(.) < filter[]/invocation() < literals/names/parenthesized. All binary infix operators left-associative. Arithmetic: + - * / ** unary-. + also string concat when both strings. Comparison: = != < <= > >= between(sugar for >=and<=) in(membership/range). Boolean: and or not() with 3-valued logic (true/false/null). Date/time/duration arithmetic: date+duration->date, datetime-datetime->duration, duration*number->duration etc. Numbers are IEEE 754 Decimal128 (34 digits). @ prefix for date/time literals (e.g. @"2019-03-31").
